name: POSLE UROKOV
source:
The last class before summer break is drawing to a close, and it's late May outside. Semyon has been sitting at the same desk with Lena for years, dreaming of confessing his feelings. But each time, he finds an excuse to postpone this important moment. And finally, he takes the plunge: Semyon asks Lena out on a date.

Experience the full range of emotions, from uncertainty to joy, and discover what happens when two hearts finally meet.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3688446704]Steam[/url]]
translation:
暑假前的最后一堂课即将结束，外面已经是五月下旬了。谢苗多年来一直与莉娜坐在同一张桌子上，梦想着坦白自己的感情。但每次他都会找借口推迟这个重要的时刻。最后，他冒险一试：谢苗约莉娜出去约会。

体验从不确定到喜悦的​​各种情感，并发现当两颗心最终相遇时会发生什么。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3688446704]Steam[/url]]
